identification: Watercolour of Eaglehawk Neck (Tasmania), titled lower left and signed 'Ernest E. Unwin' lower right, framed with cream mount. Ernest Ewart Unwin (1881-1971), Hobart watercolourist and art teacher. Small, competent landscape of a bay, hills and gum trees; photos show a genuine-looking ink signature. Unverified as to size and date.
